sources.label: Patches for morphe
sources.author: Hooman
patch_list: Turns on the built-in call recorder in regions where Google normally hides it. Recordings stay on your phone. Recording calls is regulated in many places, so check what is allowed where you live before using it.

sources.label: A collection of unofficial Android patches built with the Morphe framework. Patc
sources.author: Morning Entree
patch_list: Enables call recorder, check local laws before using it.

sources.label: Morphe patch for Google Phone's built-in manual call recording, with obfuscation
sources.author: Google Phone call recording
patch_list: Enable the existing manual recording availability gate. Requires a working privileged call-audio backend.
Report a rejected DroidGuard broker connection as DEVELOPER_ERROR instead of crashing a renamed clone. Device testing required.

patch_list: Adds customizable Google Phone feature flags.
Removes the unavailable com.google.android.dialer.support shared-library requirement.

sources.label: Turn any official Google Phone (Google Dialer) APK into a clean, true pitch-blac
sources.author: GT
patch_list: Converts Google Phone dark theme from grey into pure pitch-black (#000000), enhances dialpad readability with pure white text, and fixes unsaved contact avatar outlines.
Changes package to com.google.android.dialer.amoled for non-rooted install. Leave OFF on rooted devices to mount over stock dialer without crashing.
Prevents Google Phone from crashing on launch when running as a cloned package on non-rooted devices.
